about.overview: Sparks Auto Electrics, located at 9 Maunsell Street, has since expanded and continued to serve the vehicle owners of Christchurch. Our customers range from the domestic car owner, to the leisure craft enthusiast (both marine and camping), to the large commercial trucking fleet operators. Whatever your needs in vehicle electrical systems, we can help you.
services: WE USE ONLY THE BEST PRODUCTS ON THE MARKET

issues.title: Not mobile-friendly
issues.evidence: The page has no responsive viewport tag, so phones show a shrunken desktop layout.

issues.title: Not served over HTTPS
issues.evidence: Final URL is http://www.sparksauto.co.nz/. Browsers label this site "Not secure".

issues.title: No search description
issues.evidence: No meta description, so Google chooses random page text for search results.

issues.title: Images missing descriptions
issues.evidence: 20 of 20 images have no alt text (accessibility and SEO).

issues.title: No local-business search markup
issues.evidence: No structured data, so Google has less to show for the business.
